previous_sql:
SELECT c.country_name, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN pa.auth_status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS tasa_de_aprobacion
FROM v_payment_intent pa
JOIN dim_customer cu ON cu.customer_sk = pa.customer_sk
JOIN dim_country c ON c.country_code = cu.country_code
WHERE pa.is_test = false AND pa.event_date >= (SELECT MAX(event_date) FROM fact_payment_attempt) - INTERVAL 90 DAY
GROUP BY c.country_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY tasa_de_aprobacion DESC
LIMIT 10
question: dame los diez países con MAYOR TASA de aprobación, con su tasa en porcentaje, contando solo los que tengan al menos mil intentos
sql: SELECT c.country_name, 100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN pa.auth_status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*) AS tasa_de_aprobacion FROM v_payment_intent pa JOIN dim_customer cu ON cu.customer_sk = pa.customer_sk JOIN ref_country c ON c.country_code = cu.country_code WHERE pa.is_test = false AND pa.event_date >= (SELECT MAX(event_date) FROM fact_payment_attempt) - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY c.country_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY tasa_de_aprobacion DESC LIMIT 10
